Total revenue rose from $60,922 million in fiscal 2024 [C1][C3] to $130,497 million in fiscal 2025 [C1][C3], as stated in the filing's summary as up 114% [C2][C3]. Using these figures, the percentage change is computed by the system below.

Net income attributable to shareowners of The Coca-Cola Company was $10,631 million in 2024 and $10,714 million in 2023 [C3]. The percentage change from 2023 to 2024 is calculated from these figures, which match the FY2025 10-K comparatives [C6].

Cash provided by operating activities was $19,697 million in 2025 [C1][C2] versus $24,204 million in 2024 [C1][C2]. Using these inputs, the percentage change from 2024 to 2025 is shown below.

Total net sales (consolidated) were $574,785 million in 2023 and $637,959 million in 2024 [C7][C1]. Percent change = (637,959 − 574,785) / 574,785 × 100 ≈ the result added by the system; Amazon also reported consolidated growth of 11% for 2024 [C2].

Net cash provided by operating activities was $41,565 million in fiscal 2026 and $36,443 million in fiscal 2025 [C3], an increase of about 14% (the excerpts also describe this as a $5.1 billion increase [C1]). The system computed the exact percentage from these inputs.

Total net earnings (net income) fell from $35,153 million in FY2023 to $14,066 million in FY2024 [C4]. Calculation (percent change in total net earnings, FY2023 to FY2024): (14066 - 35153) / 35153 * 100 = -59.99%

Net income attributable to ExxonMobil for 2025 was 28,844 million dollars [C2], and total revenues and other income for 2025 was 332,238 million dollars [C2]. The net profit margin is net income attributable to ExxonMobil divided by total revenues and other income, multiplied by 100.

Calculation (net profit margin for FY2025 (percent)): 28844 / 332238 * 100 = 8.68%

Johnson & Johnson's FY2024 net earnings were $14,066 million [C1] and sales to customers were $88,821 million [C1]. Net profit margin = net earnings / sales × 100.

Net profit margin is net income divided by total net revenue. For 2023, net income was $49,552 million [C1][C3] and total net revenue was $158,104 million [C1][C3]. The system will compute the resulting percentage.

Calculation (net profit margin for FY2023 (%)): 49552 / 158104 * 100 = 31.34%

Net income attributable to Walmart for fiscal 2025 was $19,436 million [C2], and total revenues were $680,985 million [C2]. Net profit margin = 19,436 / 680,985, expressed as a percentage.

Calculation (net profit margin (net income attributable to Walmart as % of total revenues), fiscal 2025): 19436 / 680985 * 100 = 2.85%

Net profit margin is net income divided by total revenue. For fiscal 2024, net income was $88,136 million [C3] and total revenue was $245,122 million [C3]. The system will compute the resulting percentage.

Net earnings attributable to UnitedHealth Group common shareholders were $12,056 million and total revenues were $447,567 million for 2025 [C2]. Net profit margin is net earnings attributable to common shareholders divided by total revenues, using these figures [C1][C2].
